title: Salinity resistance and wind-enhanced evaporation of biomass-derived foam for sustainable solar desalination
content:

Wei Wang, Xi Huan, Jingnan Wang, Siyuan Kang, Yuheng Li, Ziyu Tian, Yining Li, Xue Wang, Jiang Fan
A convection-regulated salt-resistant evaporator with porous structure was developed for high-efficiency solar vapor generation. This stemmed from convection-improved heat loss while accelerating the vapor diffusion at the evaporator interface.
